review_basis: Independent read-only code review and synthetic localization validation; no publication PDF read and no final preparation run.

findings.finding: A supplied same-page claim could previously pass even when the prepared title was on page 10 and the exact entry anchor was on page 11.
findings.resolution: Known title and first-content claims are constrained to their prepared title and exact source-entry anchor hits. Range titles remain source-qualified and require actual content observations.
findings.verification: Independent synthetic heading10/anchor11 case is rejected specifically for the anchor mismatch; changing only the prepared anchor to10 passes.

findings.finding: An unrestricted observation merge could overwrite source metadata after validation.
findings.resolution: The merge admits only reviewer, observation, page, image and observation-record reference fields. Source identity and localization remain from the prepared item.
findings.verification: Independent review confirmed the whitelist preserves prepared source metadata.
